rule_description: Observed baseline values must never be overwritten by user assumptions or scenario calculations.
violation_action: Reject scenario run and flag for audit

rule_description: Derived parameters must be recomputed from immutable baselines; must not use scenario-adjusted values.
violation_action: Reject scenario run and flag for audit

rule_description: User-entered staff counts must be non-negative and within analytical range. Soft warning at 20.
Reduction percentages must be 0-50. Soft warning at 30. Absenteeism cannot go below 0%.
Intervention duration must be 1-90 days. Soft warning at 30.
Fixed governance references (e.g., assumption_set_id) must point to active, valid assumption sets.
Fixed boolean governance parameters must not be user-editable.
violation_action: Reject user change; flag for governance review

rule_description: Fixed governance values within defined ranges must not be user-editable.
violation_action: Reject user change; flag for governance review

rule_description: Confidence multipliers are governance-fixed; user changes require explicit governance approval.
violation_action: Reject user change; flag for governance review

rule_description: Confidence penalties are governance-fixed; user changes require explicit governance approval.
violation_action: Reject user change; flag for governance review

rule_description: No scenario may be assigned High confidence in Phase 2C-2. Maximum allowed is Moderate.
violation_action: Cap confidence at Moderate; flag for review

rule_description: Scenario outputs may inform decisions but must never trigger automatic management approval.
violation_action: Block any auto-approval mechanism; flag for governance review

rule_description: Cost, revenue, or budget impact fields must not appear in Step 2C-2 outputs.
violation_action: Reject output generation if financial fields present

rule_description: Any scenario involving kpi_003 or kpi_005 must carry provisional_kpi_warning = True.
violation_action: Add warning flag automatically; cannot be suppressed

rule_description: Every scenario run must generate a unique scenario_run_id and persist inputs, assumptions, and timestamp.
violation_action: Reject scenario run if reproducibility metadata incomplete
